timeline.label: THE BEGINNING
timeline.title: 10th standard
timeline.text: A love that began at school, before they knew how much life would ask of them.

timeline.label: CHOOSING EACH OTHER
timeline.title: The same college
timeline.text: Despite opposition at home, they joined the same college. Small misunderstandings later grew into a separation.

timeline.label: THREE YEARS APART
timeline.title: A name on a screen
timeline.text: Three years without speaking or seeing each other. Then Roshini found his name online, and they reconnected.

timeline.label: FINDING THEIR WAY BACK
timeline.title: He came back for her
timeline.text: There were struggles, arguments, and another year of silence. Mathi returned, asking to build a life with her and seeking her family’s acceptance.

timeline.label: MAY 3
timeline.title: At last, a yes
timeline.text: Her father gave his consent. They were told the wedding could happen in six months. After years of waiting, a shared future finally felt close.

timeline.label: JUNE 26
timeline.title: The evening everything changed
timeline.text: That day Mathi spoke of chest pain. Roshini asked him to go to hospital; he went home to rest. That evening, his father called to tell her Mathi had passed away.

timeline.label: A LOVE STILL CARRIED
timeline.title: Still living in his memories
timeline.text: She had imagined holding his hand through life. Now she holds their memories close, carrying their ten years of love into every day.
